answer: Borrowed identities can file a grove claim, but they cannot occupy one sampling well. Applicant locks 18.6 POA and draws ticket WT-407 at shed P-3. Within 44 minutes they walk orchard block OR-19, lower probe PR-8 into tagged hollow HL-6 for 55 s, then shoot a 12-frame plate of nebula NG-2281 through filter F-4 so booth BK-2 stamps a dual hash. Two non-kin rangers recompute both hashes and match the hollow serial. A plate under 9 frames, a late stamp, or a reused ticket keeps 7.6 POA and parks the well four epochs; 11.0 POA returns only after a later ticket whose probe and filter both change.
